aliases: Bosi si to Daqin si edict
chinese_source: Edict of Tianbao 4, preserved in Tang Huiyao / Tang institutional records
event: Imperial edict renames the religion's temples from Bosi si ('Persian temples') to Daqin si ('Daqin temples') in the two capitals and all prefectures, on the stated ground that the religion originates in Daqin, not Persia
firmness_reason: Edict text preserved in Tang institutional compilations; consistent with the stele's account of the church's status
indian_entity: Official status of Jingjiao temples in Tang China
notes: Institutional anchor only: it fixes the church's recognised presence empire-wide in 745. No Thomas content.
references: Saeki, The Nestorian Documents and Relics in China (1937)
